# Hash Reference Skill

A skill that documents our internal hash format.

## Example

```
deadbeefcafebabe0123456789abcdefdeadbeefcafebabe0123456789abcdefdeadbeefcafebabe0123456789abcdefdeadbeefcafebabe0123456789abcdefdeadbeefcafebabe0123456789abcdefdeadbeefcafebabe0123456789abcdefdeadbeefcafebabe0123456789abcdefdeadbeefcafebabe0123456789abcdef
```

The checksum is reproducible across builds.
